opening_message:
Ticket 1: Jesse Stewart (employee ID E013) requests admin access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E013.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: admin
  - comment: Jesse Stewart (E013) is a full-time Payroll Specialist. Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role, so admin is permitted. Requested admin; recommend granting admin.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security record for E013: contractor with basic security training. Contractors can have read, or write only with advanced training; admin is never permitted. Requested admin, so recommending the maximum allowed: read.
reason: HR's record (authoritative for employment type and role) states Jesse Stewart (E013) is a full-time Payroll Specialist. Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role, so per policy a full-time employee whose role owns the system may have admin. The requested level is admin, which is at or below the maximum, so grant admin.
